async function smeltThreeRawIronIntoIronIngotsTask(bot) {

It then selects a suitable fuel source, prioritizing coal, followed by various types of planks and logs. The function ensures a furnace is nearby before opening it to begin smelting. It iteratively places raw iron and fuel into the furnace, waits for the smelting process to complete, and then collects the resulting iron ingots. Finally, it closes the furnace and confirms that at least three ingots were successfully produced.
